content:
Everyone has a spiritual arena in which they function, looking at someone and what they are able to do, has so much bearing on their position in the spirit. You may copy their mannerism and not achieve what they have because you are not positioned rightly. This is what is known as functioning in the Grace given to you, it is not of works it is a function of Grace. You can move to the next level because He gives more Grace!  
_Jas 4:6 But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble._
*#GraceGalore*

A grateful heart is a joyful heart, look around you, if all you see is negativity you are missing out on the blessing of God! Remove the veil of pessimism, it will never produce good in your life. The Lord has loaded everyday with benefits just for you and Gratitude will allow you to see them and attract them to you. Be thankful, let thanksgiving be your song. 
_2Co 9:11 Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God_
*#GraceGalore*

Jesus is not a part of a Christians life, He is our life, He is the fullness of who we are and what we express as the out working of our life. To deny this, is to reject the work of the Cross, because the death of Christ was to fully accomplish substitution of Jesus' live for ours, He took our place that we may fully take on His. Now we live in Him and He in us.  
_Col 3:4 When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory_
*#GraceGalore*

The word truth in the Bible has no religious connotation. Truth is the reality of how things actually are the unchanging state of things, and the same results that will be gotten when every test, experiment or search is done. It has nothing to do with religion, it is what it is. Jesus is Truth, He is not the truth for Christianity, He is the truth for existence. He is the reality of all things! 
_Joh 14:6 Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me._
*#GraceGalore*

It shouldn't worry you that there is darkness in the world, light has never been threatened by darkness. All darkness does is to enhance the visibility of the light. As a child of God, don't be in fear what's happening around you it has not power to bring you down, you are called to be a shining light, which then darkness cannot comprehend. Light always imposes itself. 
_Phi 2:15 That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world_
*#GraceGalore*

Don't only live for breakthroughs, you are not called to have breakthrough or open doors only there is a place of going through that door to the place that you have been called to. The fullness of the call of God is not just to get you out, He brings you out to get you INTO the place of dwelling, a place of prosperity, a place of power and fulfilment. Don't stop here, the door is open that you may go through onto Perfection. 
_Rev 3:8 I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it:_
*#GraceGalore*

Unbelief is not having no belief, rather it is believing the wrong thing, when you place wrong knowledge in your mind the result will be fear and unbelief. Fear is being confidence that God is unable to help, provide or protect you. Unbelief is being confident in knowledge contrary to God's word. Praying for what God has already giving you is one of the common forms if unbelief. Get knowledge of the Truth. 
_Hos 4:6 My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me:_
*#GraceGalore*

The true measure of a man or woman is not how much they possess, who they marry or what job they have. The true measure of one's success is the impact that their life has on that of others, how are the lives of others changed because of you? How much light are you shining on your world? You are called to bring change to the lives of those around you. 
_Mat 5:16 Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven_
*#GraceGalore*

Expose your heart to a higher level of what you are desiring, with your eyes on all that you are used too, there will be no growth. Challenge yourself higher, press on to the greater and upward call of God on your life. Get a lofty vision for your life, keep looking up. 
_Col 3:1 If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God._
*#GraceGalore*

All that is known is not all there is to know, God has so much more yet to be revealed than that which is known, I dare say there is more unknown than that which is known, so use the tools of the known, but don't be limited by them, you can invent and discover new things and new methods your field, let the Holy Spirit guide you into unknown.
_Joh 16:13 Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come._
*#GraceGalore*

The greatest loss in your world is to lose yourself in trying to be someone else; in doing that, you deny the world of who you are. God made you as you are, knowing all so well the plans and purposes He has placed in you. You are enough, you are well created for the purpose of God. Be you, do you don't allow yourself to be intimidated by the success of others. 
_Eph 2:10 For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them._
*#GraceGalore*

The time has come for you to rise up to your calling and destiny; destiny always demands that you stand up and take action. Don't live passively, dont let life just happen to you, step out and do something, launch out into all that God has for you. It's your for the taking, you have enough strength, you can do so much more than you think you can, you strength is the person of the Holy Spirit inside you. 
_2Sa 22:33 God is my strength and power: and he maketh my way perfect_
*#GraceGalore*

Don't stop where you are right now, enjoy the victory, but press on to the higher call for you in Christ Jesus! Leave the elementary principles of the Faith and go onto perfection. Many have camped on the basics and believe that's all there is in life, they have ended right at the borders of there comfort zone, but there is an experience of God that you have been called to beyond the known.
_1Co 2:9 But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love Him._
*#GraceGalore*

The Lord has His hand in the affairs of your life to bring perfection to you, some people are only aware of the working of the devil and the ways of nature. Sadly when natural disasters happen they are referred to as "acts of God" but the truth is the acts of God are clearly revealed to us in Scripture, they are acts of Love, when the Lord does something, it is a clear display of His nature; Love. Open your eyes to see the love of God all around you!
_Jas 1:17 Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning_
*#GraceGalore*

You are strong and courageous in the Lord, you stand tall and confident in Christ. This is your reality, it is not something you are trying to achieve or get to, this is what is established in you, your spirit cannot produce fear or doubt, those are outside forces, you have the Holy Spirit within you, you are a shining and a burning light. Don't go by outside information, live from the truth within you. 
_Eph 3:16 That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man_
*#GraceGalore*

See yourself through the eyes of Grace, don't look away from who the death, burial and Resurrection of Jesus Christ has made you to become. Jesus did not die for nothing, the finished work of the Cross has to mean something to you, and the results ought to show. Embrace what Jesus has done and refuse anything less. 
_1Co 15:10 But by the grace of God I am what I am: and His grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me_
*#GraceGalore*

Jesus came for a reason, He came to show that a particular way of life is possible, a life of complete and perfect union with God! He showed that it is possible for God to fully take on the nature of man, and in turn He also came to show that it is possible for man to take on the full nature of God. We are raised together with Him seated in Heavenly places. 
_Eph 2:6 And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus_
*#GraceGalore* 

🎄 Compliments of the season 🎄

2019 is coming to a close it has been an awesome year and it's very important to note that what happened or didn't happen according to your plan, is not the determinant of the greatness of the year. It is who you are that determines what a day, week, month or year is. The Lord is more interested in who you are than what happens to you, let the reality of who you are be the light that shines on your experience of this year.  
_Rom 8:37 Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us_
*#GraceGalore*

The greatest impurity of the soul is fear, it corrupts the mental faculties with false information, and paralyses belief. Man was made to increase, invent, discover and make progress by constantly stepping out of his comfort zone to achieve higher heights each moment. Fear is the reason for the stagnation in any area of life, so drop the fear take up Faith today, your next level in life is beyond your fears. 
_2Ti 1:7 For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind_
*#GraceGalore*

The end of a matter is greater than the beginning you are ending strong. 2020 has nothing inherently for you, it is going to be all that you manifest from yourself, manifest the strength and power of who you are, walk in the reality of who you are in 2020, Let the Christ is you raise in 2020!
_This is the day that the Lord has made, we will rejoice and be glad in it_
*#GraceGalore*

*2020 MANIFEST ALL THAT IS IN YOU*

We judge everything based on limitations but in Christ there are no limits! 
The Order of Perfection will call you out of all the traditions you have believed about life! You are called to start your walk without barriers, what you need is a change of mindset. 
The limits are gone that which is Perfect is Come!
*#Teleiosis*
*#Iris_to_Iris* 

Have a Perfect 2020 to You

Salvation is a means to an end, leaving Egypt was not the full package of God's plan for the children of Israel. When people lose sight of God's Perfect plan they get lost and become aimless wanderers in the wilderness. Let us on to Perfection 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

There is a difference between the return of Christ and His appearing. His return to Earth is the most spectacular event yet in the history of existence, His appearing on the other hand is on going events that change the dispensations of Human existence by the revelation of who He is! He is now appearing in His people for the transformation of Creation through us.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Christianity is life, it has nothing to do with religion. Seeing into the realms of God is not hyper spiritual, it is the natural life for the man or woman in Christ! We are raised together with Him and seated in Heavenly places! Reject the mundane existence of religious creeds and dogmas that keep you to think and act outside your true nature of ONENESS with Christ! 
What which is PERFECT is come
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

How can a PERFECT God make His children imperfect? To not see His Perfection in you is to deny that He Himself is PERFECT. This is Our ONENESS with Him!
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The greatest force in the Universe is Love, all existence bows down to it's dictates. It shapes the very bounds of reality, and points out what truth is, it brings all that encounters it into Perfection! But love is more than a rule or a force, Love has a face, Love has Name, Love is a Person; JESUS
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus didn't come to make servants, in the past we were made to believe that the highest call of a believer is to become a servant of God! This however is opposed to the teaching of the Word of God, we are called to Sonship to reign with Christ as Sons of God walking in the fullness of who He is!
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is a real experience, it is what Jesus paid for in His death, burial and Resurrection. To say Jesus only died to take away sin, make his death infinitely an over payment. In the Old Testament God dealt with sin with the Children of Israel by an offering of a lamb, What reward would be counted worthy of the offering of the Son of God Himself? The Lamb of God does not only washes away sin, He perfects those who come to Him.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

One of the things that God has shown us constantly in His Word is that He is not to be kept in a box. All throughout history we see how He shattered every box that Man has ever tried to fit Him in. Traditions never fulfill the purposes of God! They end up being a snare to those that hold on to them, we are called to be continually led by the Spirit of God! The Lord is doing something new in our time, That which is PERFECT is come.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The truth of anything is only found in Christ, anything that is not Perfect in Him has not yet come to it's true state. The truth of your health, your finances, your family life etc, is only found in the reality of Christ! Accept your position in Him and refuse to walk in the falsehood of partiality. There is a perfect life for you in Christ!
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Sight is very important in your relationship with God! You cannot walk in what you cannot see, what you don't see in God you cannot experience, we are commissioned and given the right to access what we see in God! This is a spiritual reality, the truth of who you are is evidence of what you have seen, because exposure to spiritual truth is your access to it. "What do you see?"
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Hard work is not the only way to success, it is a means to which man has discovered you can achieve the success, but there are ways and revelations in God that go far beyond that has been revealed to mankind! Jesus is the way, there is a rest that remains for the children of God, it is a reality of life that is beyond what is currently at play in the system of the world today! Jesus is our Rest! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The time of the Kingdom is now, we are at a very important time in the history of mankind. If anything is going to change, it's going to be by the Kings and Priests of the Lord's kingdom taking their place and reign of regions and spheres of life and society. Jesus has made us Kings and Priests, and only through these offices can we rule over the circumstances of life.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Religion creates servants and peasants, people are made to follow rules and dogmas that never bring them to their true nature, it elevates rules over relationship, it prefers blind obedience without perfect fellowship and love. Jesus came to bring us a relational experience with God bound by Perfect Love! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

If there is anything or any area of your life that can be defined outside Christ, you have not yet come into oneness! Jesus is not a part of your life, He is not even number one in your life, the Scripture reveals to us that Christ IS OUR LIFE! The totally of who you are is Christ! We are one with Him; let us walk thus. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Thank God for all that we have known and experienced so far. The Glory of God that the Church has walked in, the victories that have be achieved so far are really worth celebrating. Despite all this there is more for us to walk in. The Lord desires His people to walk in His fullness.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Salvation was a work of God, man did not ask Him for it, He Himself saw our need for a savior and sent His own son to die for us. The same is true about Perfection, it is not the creation or idea of man, God Himself is our Perfection, He defines what it is and how one can come into it. Come up hither.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

We have come to the point in human existence where you cannot be neutral about anything anymore, the world systems that have been in office for so long are losing their hold to the Glorious raising of the sons of God! It's time to take your place! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

You are made for more than making a living, there is a divine purpose on your life that was created for you In Christ Jesus. You are here to be an expression of the image of God in Christ, live out your manifest purpose! It's time to Manifest as Son's of God! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Your default position is who you are in Christ, at rest. We are not natural beings, we weren't made from here, this Earthly realm is just holding our experience and give us an expression of our God nature. We don't define life based on how things are done on the Earth, our lives are defined by the fullness of who we are in Christ! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Understanding your origin is very important because that will define the position from which you view everything that you experience. We by default fall back to who we are, if your revelation of yourself is from your family background and the fallen state of humanity, you will not be able to see nor experience what God has for you in Christ! The reality of being in Christ is not a standard you should attain, it is the reality of how you are by default. You are Perfect.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Christianity is the reality of life beyond natural, it is the physical and the spiritual being brought into oneness with the reality of God! God is very much concerned about the physical, the full expression of the truth is the physical and the spiritual being brought into Perfection, the spiritual without the physical is not perfect. In Christ All things are brought together in one.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

In God's dealing with Israel, He established the atonement of sin, in which the sins of the nation were covered, the problem was that the people still had the sin nature in them! In the church God has dealt with the sin nature once and for all, though there are a number of things that are still shakable, God is now removing everything that can be shaken, the only that which is PERFECT remain.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

A great theme of the Bible is movement, moving to a higher place and experience with God! God is opposed to being stagnant and stationary for too long. There is more to know and experience. Therefore leaving the elementary principles of the Faith, let us go on to Perfection! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

What you focus on the most is what you become, there is a place for physically hearing the Word and then there is a place where you let yourself be changed by the reality of the Word, the Word is alive and powerful, it was not given to us as mere rules and instructions for life, there is a life to be experienced, focusing on the person of the Perfection of the Word will bring you into how He is! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

In Perfection, God no longer visits our meetings and services, He is our life the definition and experience of who we are. There is a move away from encountering God at a service, we are now seeing Him in all that we do. Christ is your life, He is not just with you, He is the full expression of your existence. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

As the Greatness of God is revealed, you will see how shameful it is to say statement's like "God is fighting for you", God is way beyond the level to fight with anything, there is nothing that can be opposition to Him, He created all things. God has no match, we are the ones who should see Him in Perfection, once we see Him as He is, it will change our experience in life. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The loss of time is that has brought about the greatest level's of regret and depression amongst men, but in Christ there is such a thing as redeeming the time. To be in Christ is to live beyond the bondage of time; time does not hold Jesus down, and you in Him have been raised together with Him, far above the principles of time and space, into the glorious reality of Christ!
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection in Christ is not something to be worked towards, it is not a product of prayer or asking, it is a manifestation of oneness with God! It takes a man who has come to the acknowledgement and actaulity of Oneness with Christ to see and manifest Perfection, as long as one is still seeking or striving for it, it will constantly elude him; Oneness is the Place of Perfection! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is the reason for salvation, we are saved to be confirmed into his image, the Perfect Image of the risen Christ! To deny Perfection is to deny the plan and purposes of God for all creation. We are to receive the end of our Faith, the complete salvation of the spirit, soul, body and creation. This is Perfection, don't settle for anything else.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*
